*[Bug 18680] Transparent lines show dark points*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=18680>

--- Comment #8 from Tomek Gieorgijewski (<mailto:cybergeorge2020@gmail.com|cybergeorge2020@gmail.com>) ---
Do you mean if the patch causes problems or the Apple's bug?
In the second case there are a few more examples what it does:

1) 
```
    s <- seq(1,100, 0.1)
    plot(s, sin(s), type="l",col="#0000004C", lwd=12)
```
This will also show that not only caps but other parts of different subpaths
will overlap with added color.

2) 

If you compare this two, you'll see how for the long sequence, dash is reset on
new subpath:
```
    plot(s, type="l",col="#0000004C", lwd=9, lty="21")

    plot(1:10, type="l",col="#0000004C", lwd=9, lty="21")
```

The patch also addresses it.
However some regression tests for plotting would be very welcome.

--- Comment #10 from Benjamin Tyner (<mailto:btyner@gmail.com|btyner@gmail.com>) ---
Considerations:
  1. What could happen if the graphics device encounters an error, the user
interrupts the rendering, or an un-handled exception occurs inside
CGContextDrawPath; could memory be leaked?
  2. What could happen if the user draws a semi-transparent line that overlaps
with itself?
  3. Will filled polygon outlines potentially suffer from anti-aliasing blur?
  4. Does the effectively move GPU-optimized computations over to the CPU?
